notes: Word Chain played through a chat interface that appears over a table is a chat word game with no logic rooms, no clue wall and nothing gated spatially, so both boundary notes point the same way and it lands in Party & Casual — I did check Puzzle's Word / Quiz preset first as that file instructs, and rejected it because its puzzle-open shape carries gate-solve and facade-clue, and this plaza has no gate to open and no riddle surface. Shape is space-bounded in the genre's own wording, where the gathering space is the play space and there are no rounds to stage, since matches happen per table rather than server-wide. Quiz is the preset with its shape kept and only tile-grid dropped, because answers are typed into the floating interface rather than stood on. Deciding without a user: this is not a SET even though a chess table with two chairs would be, because the author asked for a central stone path and enough grass to circulate, so players genuinely walk the plaza to pick a table; trigger-scoring carries the seat-occupancy detection that starts the countdown and ends a match; and the three round tables with four chairs each have no option row anywhere, so they ride as the plaza's stated furniture.
